login.title: Sign in to Rec PM

reset.title: Create a new password

workspaces.title: Your workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Choose where you want to work.
workspaces.empty: You are not part of any workspace yet.
workspaces.createDescription: One workspace per agency. Starts with a 14-day Pro trial.

dashboard.inviteTeamDesc: Managers and staff join through the invitation link.
dashboard.secureAccountDesc: Protect your account with an authenticator app.

members.title: Users

security.title: Account security
security.twoFactorDesc: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.

portal.title: Client portal
